SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'trigger' AND name IN ('signatures_assigned_identity_insert', 'signatures_assigned_identity_update', 'documents_artifact_identity_insert', 'documents_artifact_identity_update', 'signatures_versioned_insert') ORDER BY name;

SELECT 1 AS invalid FROM signatures WHERE key_assignment_state = 'assigned' AND (signing_key_id IS NULL OR trim(signing_key_id) = '' OR signed_payload_sha256 IS NULL OR trim(signed_payload_sha256) = '') LIMIT 1;

SELECT 1 AS invalid FROM documents WHERE artifact_key_assignment_state IS NULL OR artifact_key_assignment_state NOT IN ('assigned', 'legacy-unverifiable') OR (artifact_key_assignment_state = 'assigned' AND ( artifact_signature IS NULL OR trim(artifact_signature) = '' OR artifact_key_id IS NULL OR trim(artifact_key_id) = '' OR artifact_signed_at IS NULL OR trim(artifact_signed_at) = '' OR artifact_payload_sha256 IS NULL OR trim(artifact_payload_sha256) = '')) OR (artifact_key_assignment_state = 'legacy-unverifiable' AND ( (artifact_signature IS NULL AND ( artifact_key_id IS NOT NULL OR artifact_signed_at IS NOT NULL OR artifact_payload_sha256 IS NOT NULL)) OR (artifact_signature IS NOT NULL AND ( trim(artifact_signature) = '' OR (artifact_key_id IS NOT NULL AND ( trim(artifact_key_id) = '' OR artifact_key_id IS NOT ( SELECT key_id FROM sign_legacy_key_declaration WHERE singleton = 1))) OR artifact_signed_at IS NOT NULL OR artifact_payload_sha256 IS NOT NULL)))) LIMIT 1;
SELECT key_id, algorithm, public_key_b64, fingerprint_sha256, status, not_before, issuance_cutoff_at, compromised_at, retired_at, incident_ref FROM signing_keys ORDER BY not_before, key_id;
SELECT singleton, key_id FROM sign_legacy_key_declaration ORDER BY singleton;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unbound_legacy_artifacts FROM documents WHERE artifact_signature IS NOT NULL AND artifact_signature <> '' AND artifact_key_id IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unbound_legacy_signatures FROM signatures WHERE signing_key_id IS NULL;

SELECT 'audit_log' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM audit_log UNION ALL SELECT 'audit_segments' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM audit_segments UNION ALL SELECT 'document_download_tokens' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM document_download_tokens UNION ALL SELECT 'documents' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM documents UNION ALL SELECT 'download_tokens' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM download_tokens UNION ALL SELECT 'my_documents_tokens' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM my_documents_tokens UNION ALL SELECT 'sign_schema_certifications' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM sign_schema_certifications UNION ALL SELECT 'sign_legacy_key_declaration' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM sign_legacy_key_declaration UNION ALL SELECT 'sign_schema_migrations' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM sign_schema_migrations UNION ALL SELECT 'signature_placements' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM signature_placements UNION ALL SELECT 'signatures' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM signatures UNION ALL SELECT 'signing_keys' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM signing_keys UNION ALL SELECT 'signing_sessions' AS table_name, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM signing_sessions;
SELECT MAX(last_leaf_id) AS value FROM audit_segments;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS pending_leaf_count FROM audit_log WHERE id > COALESCE((SELECT MAX(last_leaf_id) FROM audit_segments), 0) AND leaf_hash IS NOT NULL;
